text_full:
The Art of Pairing with Strangers - Over Engineered Podcast

August 26, 2024

My buddy Chris Morrell was kind enough to have me on his extremely chill podcast, Over Engineered, to talk about my Pair-amid Scheme. We nerded out over making - Chris has an obsession with sewing pants, and I shared my Kilopixel project.

I honestly didn't know this was going to be a video podcast, so...let me know if I did anything embarrassing. Give it a listen!
